guides.title: Home Office Ergonomics: Practical Keyboard and Mouse Options for US & UK Buyers
guides.summary: A practical comparison of ergonomic keyboards and pointing devices, focusing on shape, connection options, hand fit and desk-work habits.
guides.introduction: Ergonomic accessories can change how your hands and arms are positioned at a desk, but no single shape suits everyone. Compare the layout, grip style, adjustment options and computer compatibility before choosing. These are research-led product summaries based on manufacturer documentation, not hands-on test results.
guides.editorialStatus: Research draft — requires human review before publication.

products.name: Logitech MX Vertical Advanced Ergonomic Mouse
products.bestFor: Users who prefer a full-size vertical mouse with a rechargeable battery.
products.us_identifier: Logitech MX Vertical Advanced Ergonomic Mouse
products.uk_identifier: Logitech MX Vertical Advanced Ergonomic Mouse
pros: 57-degree vertical orientation designed around a handshake-style grip
Rechargeable design with USB-C charging
Bluetooth and USB receiver connectivity; supports switching between compatible computers
cons: The upright grip can feel unfamiliar and may require an adjustment period
Its larger shape is not ideal for every hand size or grip preference
The vertical design is not a substitute for adjusting desk height and overall posture
products.verdict: A candidate for users who want to try a pronounced vertical mouse shape and value multi-device connectivity. Check hand fit and current regional model details before buying.
products.sourceNote: Logitech product and technical documentation describes the 57-degree angle, rechargeable power and connection options.

products.name: Logitech Lift Vertical Ergonomic Mouse
products.bestFor: Users with small-to-medium hands looking for a more compact vertical mouse.
pros: 57-degree vertical grip
Bluetooth and Logi Bolt receiver connectivity
Compact shape with programmable buttons and a replaceable AA battery
cons: The compact body may not suit larger hands
Uses a replaceable AA battery rather than USB-C rechargeable power
Vertical pointing devices require a personal comfort check before committing
products.verdict: Worth comparing with larger vertical mice when hand size is a priority. Confirm the colour and handedness variant offered in the selected Amazon marketplace.
products.sourceNote: Logitech technical specifications identify the small-to-medium hand fit, 57-degree angle and connection methods.

products.name: Logitech ERGO K860 Split Ergonomic Keyboard
products.bestFor: Frequent typists who want a full-size split keyboard with an integrated wrist rest.
products.us_identifier: Logitech ERGO K860 Split Ergonomic Keyboard
products.uk_identifier: Logitech ERGO K860 Split Ergonomic Keyboard
pros: Curved split keyframe intended to encourage a more natural hand position
Integrated cushioned wrist rest
Adjustable palm-lift feet and wireless connectivity
cons: The split layout can take time to learn
Full-size footprint requires sufficient desk space
The integrated wrist rest and non-backlit keys may not suit every workstation
products.verdict: A sensible comparison option for desk workers who prefer a full-size ergonomic keyboard. Review the layout and language/region keycap variant carefully.
products.sourceNote: Logitech product information documents the split frame, wrist rest, palm-lift positions and wireless options.

products.name: Logitech MX Ergo S Wireless Trackball Mouse
products.bestFor: Users who prefer thumb-controlled trackball navigation and want to reduce mouse travel across the desk.
products.us_identifier: Logitech MX Ergo S Wireless Trackball Mouse
products.uk_identifier: Logitech MX Ergo S Wireless Trackball Mouse
pros: Trackball operation keeps the mouse body stationary during cursor movement
Adjustable 20-degree tilt
Customisable buttons and USB-C charging
cons: Thumb-operated trackballs have a distinct learning curve
The sculpted body is designed for medium-to-large hands
Trackball cleaning and maintenance differ from a conventional optical mouse
products.verdict: Consider it if you want a stationary pointing device and are comfortable learning thumb-controlled tracking. It is a different interaction style, not a universal ergonomic solution.
products.sourceNote: Logitech product documentation describes the trackball, tilt angle, hand fit and customisable controls.

guides.title: Portable Power & Travel Tech: Power Banks and Compact Power Stations
guides.summary: Compare high-capacity USB-C power banks and compact portable power stations for mobile work, travel and backup use.
guides.introduction: Portable power products vary significantly in capacity, output, weight, charging method and transport restrictions. A USB power bank is not interchangeable with a mains-output power station. Check device charging requirements, airline rules, regional plug versions and the manufacturer's current specifications before purchase.
guides.editorialStatus: Research draft — requires human review before publication.

products.name: Anker 737 Power Bank (PowerCore 24K, A1289)
products.bestFor: Laptop and phone users who need a high-output USB-C power bank.
pros: 24,000mAh stated capacity
Up to 140W maximum output
Two USB-C ports and one USB-A port with an information display
cons: Its 630g stated weight is substantial for a pocket-sized travel charger
Maximum output depends on the connected device and a suitable cable
Does not provide AC mains sockets
products.verdict: A strong specification-led candidate for charging compatible laptops and mobile devices over USB. Check airline power-bank limits and the exact regional package.
products.sourceNote: Anker product specifications list 24,000mAh, 140W maximum output, port count and weight.

products.name: Anker Prime Power Bank (27,650mAh, 250W)
products.bestFor: Power users who need multiple high-output USB-C connections in a portable battery.
pros: 27,650mAh stated cell capacity
Up to 250W combined output across its ports
Two USB-C ports and one USB-A port, with app-based monitoring
cons: At 665g it is relatively heavy for everyday pocket carry
Maximum output is shared across ports and depends on device/cable requirements
High-capacity power-bank airline carriage rules must be checked before travel
products.verdict: A high-output option for users carrying laptops and several mobile devices. Confirm the A1340 model, local stock and applicable airline battery rules.
products.sourceNote: Anker UK identifies model A1340, 27,650mAh capacity, up to 250W total output and port configuration.

products.name: EcoFlow RIVER 2 Portable Power Station
products.bestFor: Short trips, small electronics and portable backup where AC output is needed.
pros: 256Wh LFP battery capacity
300W pure-sine-wave AC output with stated surge capability
AC, USB-C, USB-A, car and solar charging inputs/outputs, depending on regional version
cons: Approximately 3.5kg, so it is not a pocket-sized travel charger
AC socket voltage and frequency differ between US and UK versions
300W output limits the appliances it can run; check startup surge and continuous wattage
products.verdict: A compact power-station candidate for small electronics and low-wattage equipment. Select the correct US or UK electrical version; never assume the socket voltage is interchangeable.
products.sourceNote: EcoFlow UK specifications list 256Wh LFP capacity, 300W AC output, 230V regional output and approximately 3.5kg weight.

products.name: Jackery Explorer 300 Plus Portable Power Station
products.bestFor: Travellers and campers seeking a compact power station for small electronics.
products.us_identifier: Jackery Explorer 300 Plus Portable Power Station
products.uk_identifier: Jackery Explorer 300 Plus Portable Power Station
pros: 288Wh LiFePO4 battery capacity
300W rated AC output with pure-sine-wave output
Portable format with solar and car charging input support
cons: Approximately 3.75kg, which is heavier than a conventional power bank
The US and European versions have different AC input/output voltage specifications
300W output is not suitable for many high-demand appliances
products.verdict: A small power-station option for camping and portable electronics. Choose the correct regional version and check the appliance's continuous and startup power needs.
products.sourceNote: Jackery Europe identifies model JE-300B, 288Wh LiFePO4 battery, approximately 3.75kg weight and regional AC specifications.

guides.title: Smart Home Security Cameras: Battery, Solar and Wi-Fi Options
guides.summary: A practical comparison of wire-free and connected home security cameras, including storage, subscriptions, Wi-Fi and installation considerations.
guides.introduction: A security camera should be selected around its installation location, power source, Wi-Fi coverage, recording needs and ongoing service costs. Resolution alone does not determine whether a camera is right for a home. Check regional availability, subscription terms, privacy settings and compatibility before purchase.
guides.editorialStatus: Research draft — requires human review before publication.

products.name: eufy SoloCam S340
products.bestFor: Outdoor monitoring where solar-assisted charging, local storage and pan-and-tilt coverage are priorities.
pros: Dual-camera system with wide-angle and telephoto views
Removable solar panel and built-in local storage
Pan-and-tilt movement, spotlight and on-device motion/person/vehicle detection
cons: Uses 2.4GHz Wi-Fi rather than dual-band Wi-Fi
Battery cameras do not provide continuous 24/7 recording
Solar charging performance depends on sunlight, placement and activity levels
products.verdict: A useful option to compare for outdoor areas where solar positioning and local recording are practical. Check HomeBase compatibility and the regional package contents.
products.sourceNote: eufy specifications describe the dual cameras, solar panel, local storage, Wi-Fi band and recording limitations.

guides.title: Wi-Fi 7 Home Routers & Mesh Systems: Options for US and UK Homes
guides.summary: Compare four Wi-Fi 7 router and mesh-system families by wireless standard, wired ports, coverage design and regional compatibility.
guides.introduction: Wi-Fi 7 equipment is not automatically faster in every home. Real results depend on the broadband plan, client devices, radio conditions, building materials and whether a mesh system uses wireless or wired backhaul. Compare the exact hardware kit and regional version before buying; the models below are research-led options, not hands-on test winners.
guides.editorialStatus: Research draft — requires human review before publication.

products.name: TP-Link Deco BE63 Wi-Fi 7 Mesh System
products.bestFor: Homes that need a multi-node mesh system with Wi-Fi 7 and multi-gigabit Ethernet ports.
products.us_identifier: TP-Link Deco BE63 Wi-Fi 7 Mesh System
products.uk_identifier: TP-Link Deco BE63 Wi-Fi 7 Mesh System
pros: Tri-band Wi-Fi 7 across 2.4GHz, 5GHz and 6GHz bands
Four 2.5Gbps Ethernet ports per unit in the documented US hardware version
Mesh roaming support using 802.11k/v/r standards
cons: Coverage and speed vary with node placement, walls and client capabilities
The cited port and radio specifications are for the US BE63 hardware; confirm the exact UK kit and regional SKU
A multi-node system can be unnecessary for smaller homes with good single-router coverage
products.verdict: A mesh-system candidate for larger or multi-room homes where several access points and multi-gig wired connections are useful. Verify the exact regional package, node count and firmware feature set.
products.sourceNote: TP-Link's BE63 US datasheet lists Wi-Fi 7 tri-band operation, four 2.5Gbps Ethernet ports per unit and mesh roaming standards; specifications may vary by region.

products.name: ASUS RT-BE96U Wi-Fi 7 Router
products.bestFor: Advanced users who prefer a standalone high-performance router with 10Gbps networking and extensive configuration options.
pros: Tri-band Wi-Fi 7 with 2.4GHz, 5GHz and 6GHz radios
One 10Gbps WAN/LAN port and a separate 10Gbps LAN port
AiMesh support for compatible ASUS routers and nodes
cons: Large external-antenna design needs suitable placement
A single router may not cover every multi-storey or thick-wall home
To benefit from Wi-Fi 7 and 10Gbps ports, connected devices and broadband equipment must also support suitable speeds
products.verdict: A specification-rich standalone router to compare for users with multi-gig broadband, wired network equipment or a preference for ASUS configuration features. Check local regulatory and hardware variants.
products.sourceNote: ASUS technical specifications list Wi-Fi 7 tri-band support, two 10Gbps Ethernet interfaces, AiMesh modes and supported wireless standards.

products.name: Amazon eero Pro 7 Tri-Band Wi-Fi 7 Router
products.bestFor: Households seeking a simple app-managed Wi-Fi 7 network with multi-gigabit wired connections and eero mesh expansion.
pros: Tri-band Wi-Fi 7 with Multi-Link Operation support
Two auto-sensing 5GbE ports
Supports eero mesh expansion and smart-home connectivity including Thread and Zigbee
cons: Advanced security and management features are offered through an optional eero Plus subscription
Best suited to users comfortable managing the network through the eero app
Coverage figures are manufacturer estimates and depend on building layout and interference
products.verdict: A practical ecosystem-led option for households that value app-based setup and mesh expansion. Confirm the local model, supported radio channels and any subscription features required.
products.sourceNote: eero's product and support documentation lists Wi-Fi 7, MLO, two 5GbE ports, mesh compatibility and smart-home connectivity; eero Plus adds optional advanced services.

products.uk_identifier: NETGEAR Orbi 770 Series RBE773 Wi-Fi 7 Mesh System
